title: State Bridge No. 177, Brackenville Road, Spanning Mill Creek, Hockessin, New Castle County, DE
notes: Significance: Bridge No. 177 is a representative example of a stone single-arch wagon bridge, typical of mid-nineteenth-century bridges built with local labor and materials along roads in New Castle County and other areas of the Mid-Atlantic region.
